XXIX. Seculum imprimis à Christo nato Sextum pro-

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are run together in the scan; they were transcribed as the text they belong beside. The Greek words (ταμβασιλεία, ἀξίας) are printed in Greek and their accents are uncertain. Right margin notes are reproduced approximately where the print is cramped.
